transcription_check.checked_by: Codex translation worker; same-agent review, no independent specialist review
transcription_check.evidence: Individually inspected all20 Poppler page images /tmp/semetey1-volta-0804-0823/page-0804.png through page-0823.png, scale1600. Read left column then right column; page805 has four narrative blocks surrounding an editorial heading; page820 has a chapter heading before two narrative columns. All running titles, folios, printer signatures and chapter headings explicitly classified; all indented continuations grouped, preserving exact raw glyphs, IDs and bboxes. No fixed row assumption. Primary Kyrgyz/Russian Yudakhin dictionary and Kyrgyz editorial glossaries used only as lexical aids. No previous English poem translation used.
transcription_check.pair_review: All 1538 reconstructed Kyrgyz-English pairs read in source order: nine blocks of150 and final188. All22 final revised pairs and19 held pairs separately reread against exact Kyrgyz. 19 whole unresolved verses excluded with complete source fragments and reasons. Every repetition retained. Narrative covers Semetey demanding return to Talas, Temir offering an army, genealogy, Korpozhan demanding inheritance, horse selection, Sary Khan elevation, Chachykei marriage and prior Toltoy betrothal, departure caravan and falcon hunting. Source allegations, threats, traditional marriage ages, numbers, miracles and contradictions retained without invented harmonization. Same-agent review, no expert certification.

alignment_check.scope: All source-English pairs and all revised pairs individually read. Final 1519 English verses have unique canonical first-source IDs; grouped fragments and explicit nonverse/unresolved exclusions account for every extraction record on PDF804–823 except20 watermarks.

publication_basis: New direct model Kyrgyz-to-English translation of traditional epic narrative. No machine-translation API or previous English poem translation used. Kyrgyz/Russian dictionaries and Kyrgyz editorial glosses are lexical aids only; provisional translation and lineation, no expert certification.
